name: Shiori
source:
An elemental mage and adept adventurer with a short temper. It’s traditional for RPG parties to include a traitor… and most people believe it’s her. Fortunately, that’s not true. She has everyone’s best interests at heart. Probably.

[From [url=https://visualnoveler.com/ascendant-hearts]official website[/url]]
